question.text: ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme) has a:

answer.text: 3-year lock-in, tax deduction under Sec 80C (old regime)

explanation.text: The Logic: ELSS = 3-year lock-in with 80C benefit (up to Rs. 1.5 lakh) under old regime. The Trap: Other features misstate ELSS. Cross-Exam Context: Same in V-A, X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: ELSS is typically the shortest 80C lock-in; good for tax-savers with equity appetite.
